requirement.statement: The Vue schema-editor capsule SHALL resolve stable presenter ids through an explicitly composed UI-toolkit-neutral SchemaEditorPresenterRegistry without exposing ValueHost, session, runtime or persistence capabilities to presenter components.

case.given: A registry contains probe adapters for stable presenter ids
case.when: The recursive renderer resolves plan presenters
case.then: Each id SHALL resolve deterministically to its scoped adapter/component implementation and unknown ids SHALL produce diagnostics without an implicit raw fallback

case.given: A presenter component is mounted by the renderer
case.when: Its public props and emitted events are inspected
case.then: It SHALL receive renderer projection data and a normalized-event listener only, and SHALL NOT receive ValueHost, SchemaEditorSession, app runtime, host writer or global registry capabilities

requirement.statement: The Vue renderer SHALL recursively render all EditorPlan node kinds from the current immutable accepted snapshot without reopening StructureSchema, rerunning dialect selection or mutating the plan.

case.given: A renderer-complete plan containing group, field, collection, map, union and custom nodes
case.when: The plan is rendered with probe presenters
case.then: The renderer SHALL project typed metadata, values, options, diagnostics and recursive children from EditorPlan and the accepted snapshot only

case.given: A plan references an unregistered presenter id
case.then: It SHALL fail closed with an observable diagnostic and SHALL NOT select JSON textarea or another implicit component

requirement.statement: Collection and map rendering SHALL materialize immutable wildcard templates from each accepted snapshot using ordered concrete wildcard bindings and stable renderer-only Vue identities.

case.given: A nested collection/map plan whose templates contain multiple wildcard segments
case.when: Accepted values are rendered and a nested presenter emits an event
case.then: Wildcards SHALL bind outer-to-inner to actual indexes or keys for value lookup and session dispatch without creating static plan children

case.given: A collection uses property identity with ephemeral fallback or explicit ephemeral identity
case.when: deep-cloned accepted insert, remove, move and reorder snapshots are published
case.then: Valid unique property identities SHALL win and renderer-local fallback keys SHALL reconcile by descriptor-safe structural occurrence without entering domain values or ValueHost requests

case.given: An outer collection reorder changes accepted array indexes while a nested collection retains the same projected outer item
case.when: The nested collection is rendered from the next accepted snapshot
case.then: Its identity scope SHALL use renderer-local outer keys while presenter events SHALL expose only actual ordered wildcard indexes or map keys

requirement.statement: The renderer SHALL convert a descriptor-safe normalized presenter event into exactly one matching plan-owned Command template dispatch and SHALL rerender values only from SchemaEditorSession accepted projections.

case.given: A presenter emits a serializable event whose name matches one node Command binding
case.then: It SHALL call session.dispatch with that template, payload and current wildcard bindings, and SHALL NOT call ValueHost or apply the command locally

case.given: An event is malformed, unknown or matches duplicate bindings
case.then: It SHALL fail closed observably and SHALL NOT dispatch a partial or guessed command

case.given: A host request is pending, rejected, conflicted, stale or accepted
case.then: Only the session's accepted snapshot SHALL change rendered values; pending and diagnostics MAY change presentation state without optimistic value mutation

requirement.statement: The existing CanonicalHalfcodeRenderer SHALL resolve the sole schemaEditor.Editor atom through controlled component registry integration and SHALL own only Vue subscriptions and renderer-local projections.

case.given: A real lowered Schema Editor source bundle and scoped runtime capabilities
case.when: The sources pass the real loader, compiler and app runtime and the existing canonical renderer mounts the resulting plan
case.then: The sole schemaEditor.Editor atom SHALL resolve to the Schema Editor shell without a parallel renderer, loader, runtime or lowering path

case.given: The shell is mounted, replaced, unmounted and remounted while host work may complete late
case.then: Each mounted shell SHALL have exactly one active session subscription, old listeners SHALL be removed, and the shell SHALL NOT dispose a Scope-owned shared session

requirement.statement: The Vue schema-editor capsule SHALL depend only on public contract/support/Vue APIs and SHALL NOT own Element Plus presenters, Flow/XNL/VFS/database mutation, direct ValueHost execution, optimistic accepted state or a global registry.

case.given: The Vue package root, schema-editor source graph and tests
case.when: public-surface, dependency and forbidden-capability checks run
case.then: The capsule SHALL expose stable root APIs, preserve three-parameter processor boundaries and contain no deep imports or excluded ownership
